[SWS_CM_00041] E2E-protected Methods Arguments Serialization
⌈
For
E2E-protected Method requests, operator() shall serialize the Method’s in and
inout arguments and potentially add a protocol header according to the rules of the respective network binding (e.g., according to [SWS_CM_10301] in case of SOME/IP
network binding), resulting in the serialized data.
⌋
